name: Hongtai Hu
headline: Exploring the reliability of compilers and developer tools.
intro: I am a master's student in Computer Science and Technology at Xiamen University. My interests lie in software engineering, fuzzing, compilers, and systems programming.
researchIntro: I study how language servers behave when source code, requests, or execution conditions push them beyond the ordinary. My work turns crashes into small, reproducible reports that upstream developers can act on.

education.school: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics

fuzz.title: Fuzzing language servers
fuzz.description: Building on LSPFuzz (ASE 2025), I extended the testing workflow and explored LLM-generated, semantics-aware mutators. I investigated failures across source inputs, LSP request sequences, and server lifecycle boundaries.

steps.title: Find
steps.description: Exercise language servers with mutated source code and LSP request sequences.

steps.title: Reduce
steps.description: Minimize inputs and requests while preserving the original failure.

steps.title: Investigate
steps.description: Inspect crash traces, compare versions, and prepare reproducible evidence.

steps.title: Follow through
steps.description: Report upstream and help clarify, reproduce, and track the resulting fixes.

cvBullets: Extended an existing LSPFuzz-based testing workflow using Rust, LibAFL, and LLM-generated, semantics-aware mutators via LiteLLM.
Tested Clang/clangd, ZLS, rust-analyzer, and Sorbet; minimized source inputs and LSP sequences, and prepared crash traces and cross-version reproduction evidence.
At least 36 LLVM reports have corresponding merged fixes, including 3 patches submitted by me. A further 3 reports have merged fixes in ZLS (1) and Sorbet (2).

cases.title: A rename request outlives the server
cases.description: A pending rename task could access server state during shutdown and trigger an assertion. The upstream fix also covered an in-flight tweak command.

cases.title: A template annotation outlives its storage
cases.description: A template-id declarator combined with a lambda default argument exposed a use-after-free in template annotation handling.

cases.title: An invalid declaration crashes selection ranges
cases.description: Requesting selection ranges for a malformed variadic function declaration caused ZLS to unwrap a missing value and panic.

emulator.title: A RISC-V 32-bit emulator
emulator.description: Implemented instruction decoding, CPU execution, device models, and exception handling. Ran The Legend of Sword and Fairy on the emulator to exercise the system.
